HG18-fxw1: Say, “I am bringing back only what is useful now. All that is not needed at this time will remain safely stored away until such time as I am ready. I am now coming back to this place and to my body and to normal day to day living, and to one honest action. All instructions to go deeper or stay in this session are now over. I keep only the ordinary-life intention or future-practice cue I consciously chose, and neither one keeps today’s altered state running. I am myself, in my body, with my adult judgment fully available.”
HG18-fxw2:
In the event that a recording that you are listening to stops unexpectedly, simply say to yourself “the recording has stopped and the session is over” and then use the above method to come out by opening your eyes, saying where you are, saying what day it is, pushing down with your feet or your hands, moving about, looking around and then using the 5 step method. Don’t sit there waiting for the voice to come back and release you.

Note: If you are using a recording to go to sleep, then it is all right to let the recording put you to sleep or have you in a quiet resting state. However, if it’s a recording for waking practice, then it should not leave you in a role, with lowered judgement, impaired movement capabilities, blank, with an undefined reset word, or invited to stay altered indefinitely.
HG24-fxw1:
Troubleshooting

Nothing happens

Start smaller:

“Show me one body sensation.” “Show me one word.” “Show me whether today is for listening or resting.”

It feels fake

What is it that feels fake? The words, an image, an expectation, a role? Be clear that not experiencing the inner voice/image is not, by itself, resistance or lack of adult capacity. If something is inviting you to do something you explicitly don’t want to do, correct it. It may also be a part that is protecting you, if so talk to it:
HG24-fxw2: It may be that an adult capacity you need is not yet available to you, in that case stop trying to make yourself have an inner voice that you believe and if you have enough observing ego, borrow the warmth, boundary or direction you need from a caring someone (real or imagined) who has it. Try out one believable sentence or action etc and see how it goes.
HG06-fxw1:
